input.prompt: A realistic photograph of an ordinary city street on a rainy morning: people with umbrellas wait at a crosswalk, cars, wet asphalt, grey sky, and the rain pours down on all of them as usual. Everything is completely normal except one impossible thing: in a small circle around one young woman standing still in the middle of the crowd without an umbrella, holding an opened letter, the raindrops hang frozen in mid-air, motionless, like tiny glass beads. Outside that circle, the rain keeps falling.
